items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, this architect was talking to us... So I snatched the stick out of his hand

ctx.x: Yeah, this architect was talking to us.

Yeah. So I went and -- well, went to walk around Tunis a little bit. So as we were going into the hall to eat, you know, there were some little Arab kids on the street, and this Frenchman had a stick, beating them. So I snatched the stick out of his hand, and I said, 'I'll beat you with this stick if you hit the kid again.' And he said, 'Oh, stay out of it.' I said, 'I won't stay out of anything. Now, you don't beat him anymore or I'm going to beat you good.' He said, 'Oh, you're crazy. Vous etes fou.' I said,…
